### lit40-hard-03-025 — skill central_ideas_details · 유형 narrator_attitude · 요청 난이도 hard · hard 기준: 말투와 행동의 어긋남을 읽어야 하고, 네 선택지가 같은 양가 구조라 형식 단서가 없다

Dainius had been retired from the sea for nine years when I moved into the flat beside his, near the old customs checkpoint on the edge of Krakow, and he spent most of my first year, as far as I could tell, telling me what I was doing wrong. My bins stood in the wrong place. My bicycle leaned at the wrong angle. I joked to my sister that he had mistaken the courtyard for a deck and me for a careless deckhand. Then the March storm tore up the strip of earth behind the empty booth, and a rusted tin surfaced there, full of letters in a language neither of us could read. He stood at his window a long while looking at the hole, then drew his curtain. I was not afraid of him, not really; I just preferred the stairs when I heard his door. Still, I was the one who carried the tin to the translator downtown, and I have kept what she told me in my desk drawer, unopened in its envelope, until he asks.

[질문] Which choice best describes the narrator's attitude toward Dainius?
A) She makes fun of his rules while avoiding him whenever she can.
B) She looks after him while hoping to make amends for her jokes.
C) She sees him as a stern captain while accepting his rule of the courtyard.
D) She teases him about his rules while guarding him from unwelcome news.
### lit40-hard-03-026 — skill central_ideas_details · 유형 main_idea_or_purpose · 요청 난이도 hard · hard 기준: 요지가 한 사건이 아닌 두 사건의 관계이며, 오답이 모두 지문 사실과 양립하는 부분 요지·인과 뒤집기다
[지문]
When the ship docked at Accra for supplies, the captain announced that whichever of his two bakers produced the better loaf by evening would keep the galley for the next voyage. Thiago and Ngozi had shared that narrow galley for six years without sharing a single recipe. By late afternoon Thiago's loaf came out black on one side, and he swore that Ngozi had nudged the oven door open as she passed. The cabin boy, who had been peeling yams in the corner, said he had seen Ngozi close the door, not open it. Nobody asked why a sack of Ngozi's own flour lay split on the floor beside Thiago's station. That night the captain tasted Ngozi's loaf and gave her the galley. In the morning, before the ship sailed, she left a second loaf, baked from the flour in the split sack and shaped with Thiago's three-cut top, wrapped in a cloth on the shelf above his bunk. Thiago found it there as he packed and carried it, still wrapped, down the gangway.

[질문] Which choice best states the main idea of the passage?
A) A parting gift recasts an earlier accusation, hinting that the rivalry held unspoken care.
B) An accusation over a burnt loaf shows how little the two bakers trust each other.
C) A captain's contest ends with one baker keeping the galley and the other departing.
D) A baker's guilt over a spoiled loaf leads her to leave a parting gift behind.
